name: Revise an Accepted Campaign Hero
description: Apply one bounded revision to the accepted campaign hero while recording the exact change, preservation instructions, allowed response, and parent contract.

data.comment:
# Revise an Accepted Campaign Hero

The accepted hero is the only editing source. Capture Change, Preserve, and Allow to respond in a child contract, make one image edit, and wait for its result before opening revision review.

data.name: hero
data.description: Accepted campaign hero. This is the primary and only editing source.

data.name: change
data.value: Move the scene from late afternoon to blue hour.

data.name: preserve
data.value: Keep the cup, camera position, composition, stone surface, headline, CTA, and spacing.

data.name: allow
data.value: Let reflections, shadows, and the sky respond to the light.
data.description: What may respond naturally to the change.

data.negative_prompt: added text, changed product, changed logo, changed camera, duplicate product
